identity: The generic request description calls this product_id; the linked v3/v4 posting requirements explicitly identify their SKU lists as the values to submit to this method. Bind to an exact required posting SKU, never a Seller card ID.
readback: Fresh posting requirements can prove that the country obligation no longer applies. These endpoints do not return the stored country ISO value. Reconciliation means country_requirement_resolution, never ISO value verification.
unknown: A cleared requirement cannot resolve an unknown write or justify resending it.

weight.reason: No verified measurement unit for new/edited weight. Existing exact native numeric values may be preserved only with fresh per-unit provider observation, never converted or supplied by the merchant.
